evidence.note: Diogenes Laertius III.62 explicitly includes Demodocus in the list of dialogues acknowledged as spurious.
Jażdżewska (2022) treats Demodocus among pseudo-Platonic / Appendix Platonica dialogues.

rationale: Ancient testimony explicitly rejects Demodocus as Platonic, and modern specialist discussion continues to treat it within the pseudo-Platonic corpus. D records authorship judgment only; the text remains historically relevant to the attribution catalog.
